(Reuters) - Dogecoin lost more than a third of its price on Sunday, after Tesla chief and cryptocurrency supporter Elon Musk called it a 'hustle' on "Saturday Night Live." 05/07/2021

Musk is simply the most amazing promoter, that's it. Pure self interest. https://t.co/6NKMZCKuAA

@cryptocom Musk said on SNL he wouldn't buy Doge for his grandmother. It immediately dropped from $.76 to $.39. Oh, but he promoted it which led to his appearance.

Dogecoin was released on December 6, 2013 as a joke to satirize the popularity of cryptocurrencies.

@GuntherEagleman I studied Musk the entrepreneur and master crowd pleaser since 2013. He declared Dogecoin a parody on crypto, yet, he is the staunch champion for the industry. Fraud hunting is no joke though.
